skirmish.module.damage_numbers.name: Damage Numbers
skirmish.module.damage_numbers.descripti: Floating numbers over nearby entities whose health changes: damage, crits, totem pops and heals in their own colours. Never visible through blocks; invisible players get no numbers.
skirmish.module.damage_numbers.setting.l: Seconds a number rises and fades
skirmish.module.damage_numbers.setting.o: Show damage only after your own hits (heals only on entities you hit recently)
skirmish.module.damage_numbers.setting.h: Green numbers when health goes up (regeneration, absorption)
